title: 6B Online Blunders — Идиомы: ошибки и проколы

items.example: He really put his foot in it when he criticised her cooking.
I dropped the ball and forgot to attach the file.
After sending that email, I had to face the music.
He had to eat humble pie after blaming his colleague.
The photo is already online — no use crying over spilt milk.
Posting that joke shot him in the foot at work.
The funny invitation backfired and confused everyone.
Nobody owned up to deleting the invitation.
She came clean and told the boss what had happened.
He learnt the hard way to always check the recipients list.

items.idiom: make a mountain out of a molehill
items.example: It was a small typo — don't make a mountain out of a molehill.
You can't just sweep a mistake like that under the carpet.
To add insult to injury, the photo got three hundred likes.
My apology fell through the cracks and never reached her.
Sorry I tagged you by mistake — my bad!
